message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have your password. To log in, you’ll need to either enter the correct password or reset it using the “Forgot Password” option on the login page. Once you’ve reset it, let me know the new password (or just confirm you’re logged in) and I’ll help you proceed.

But we can't guess. So we should respond asking for password or advise to reset. According to policy, we cannot provide or guess password. So we should ask for password or direct them to reset. Also we have a tool to authenticate. But we don't have password. So we can't call it. So we should respond politely.
